title: Pumpkin Snickerdoodles
summary: Gluten-free: soft, bite-sized, mildly spiced, barely sweet.
intro: **The gluten-free flour is key to the best texture.** Regular flour will produce gummy cookies.

equipment.note: Medium bowl for the dry ingredients; large bowl for the wet, and adding the dry.
To easily blend the butter and sugar.

steps: **Mix** with a fork and set aside to mix in later. This is the *dry mix*.
**Mix** with a fork and set aside for coating the cookie balls. This is the *coating*.

pace.text: Add the dry mix straight away.

steps: **Slowly add** the dry mix with the hand mixer.

pace.text: The dough is fine in the fridge for several days.

steps: **Scoop** tablespoon portions and roll them into balls.
**Coat** each dough ball and place on the cookie sheet. 2-inch spacing is just enough for spreading during the bake.

pace.text: The coated balls are fine in the fridge for several days.

steps: **Dry mix:** {qty:1 1/2 cups} GF flour, {qty:1 tsp} each of salt, cream of tartar, baking powder and nutmeg.
**Coating:** {qty:1/3 cup} sugar, {qty:1 tsp} cinnamon, {qty:1/4 tsp} cloves, {qty:1/4 tsp} nutmeg.
**Beat:** {qty:1/2 cup} soft butter, {qty:1 cup} sugar, {qty:1} egg, {qty:1/2 cup} pumpkin.
keys: Gluten-free flour, or they go gummy
Dough and coated balls keep for days in the fridge
